title: MSVC linker not found — switched to GNU toolchain
content:
- **link.exe not found** — `.cargo/config.toml` forced `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` target with paths to VS 2019 BuildTools (`C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft Visual Studio/2019/BuildTools/...`) that don't exist on this machine.
- **Fix**: Changed `.cargo/config.toml` to use `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` target with `x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc` linker. GNU toolchain was already installed via rustup. Removed stale `CC/CXX/AR/INCLUDE/LIB` env vars pointing to non-existent VS paths.
